title: Accuracy cost of the privacy budget
caption: Test accuracy below the nonprivate reference at selected privacy budgets, from published DP-SGD results (Abadi 2016, Bu 2020, De 2022). MNIST stays within about 8 points at single-digit epsilon; CIFAR-10 trained from scratch at epsilon = 8 sits 14 to 22 points below its baseline. The cost is task-dependent, not a property of epsilon alone.

title: Per-worker gradient traffic, N = 64
caption: Bytes each worker moves per step for one gradient payload M. Ring AllReduce circulates about 2M; a gather-based coordinate-wise median receives all 63 peer gradients, about 63M, a 32x multiplier that lands in the CommunicationTime term of the Fleet Law.
